get_priority_int: get the priority value from an integer between 0 and 100
get_priority_enum: get the priority value from a Priority enum member like Priority.HIGH
get_priority_string: get the priority value from a string like 'normal' or 'lowest'
use_priority_enum: use the Priority enum to define hook priority levels from HIGHEST to LOWEST
review_priority_validation: review the get_priority function to understand validation for out of range integers
